purpose: Validate a corrected change-evidence contract before amending Canon 19 §E.
syntheticSecretsOnly: all secret bodies contain the literal marker JUQODE_SYNTHETIC_SECRET — no real credential exists in this fixture

secretExclusion.question: Does a JuQode-owned exclusion keep secrets out even when .gitignore does not list them, INCLUDING secrets the user already committed?
secretExclusion.note: A :(exclude) pathspec alone is NOT sufficient — it only filters what `add` considers. Already-tracked secrets survive in the copied index and would still be referenced by write-tree.

oldIgnoredCheck.question: Can `git status --ignored=matching` before/after see a MODIFICATION to an existing ignored file?
oldIgnoredCheck.conclusion: Identical output despite a real modification — the approved mechanism is silent exactly when it matters.

replacementLedger.question: Does a (path,size,mtime_ns) ledger detect a change to an EXCLUDED file without reading it?

userRepoUntouched.question: Is the user index/worktree byte-identical after both captures?
